name: Kaposszerdahely (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, blue, white and blue, charged near the top of the white with the municipal arms of Kaposszerdahely: a red shield with a white cross and a fleur-de-lis.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
